auth_type.description: The `OAuth` value must be specified for this type of authorization.

named_range.description: The name of the named data range on the sheet that contains the data to be synced.

sheet_id.description: The URL of the sheet that can be copied from the browser address bar, or the ID of the sheet that can be found in the sheet's URL between **/d/** and **/edit**.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Google Sheets client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Google Sheets client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
